text: {"danger_level":"red","danger_reason":"Fire could reach this spot within about 1 hour based on forward spread estimated at roughly 10% of open wind speed for forests and shrublands.","main_move":"EVACUATE_AWAY_FROM_FIRE","main_move_text":"Leave now — away from the fire, never downwind","where_to_go":"Go to Safe point outside the danger zone to the NW, which is 939 m away (12.5 minutes walk) via Front Street.","do_now":[{"text":"Evacuate immediately if authorities tell you to do so and check local sources or the FEMA app for shelters.","advice_ids":["wf.evacuate"]},{"text":"Pay attention to emergency alerts and notifications for information and instructions.","advice_ids":["wf.alerts"]},{"text":"Turn on lights to help rescuers find you.","advice_ids":["wf.trapped_lights"]},{"text":"Be cautious with flammable products like aerosols, cooking oils, and rubbing alcohol.","advice_ids":["wf.flammables"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not move downwind, approach the fire, or wait until flames are visible.","advice_ids":["wf.evacuate"]},{"text":"Do not return home until authorities say it is safe to do so.","advice_ids":["wf.return"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"outdoors","text":"Avoid hot ash, charred trees, smoldering debris, and live embers.","advice_ids":["wf.embers"]},{"situation":"vehicle","text":"Exercise caution with flammable products and avoid hot ash or live embers.","advice_ids":["wf.flammables","wf.embers"]}],"call":["911 - Emergency (police, fire, ambulance)"],"confidence":"medium","confidence_reason":"The danger zone is based on a spread-rate rule of thumb rather than official distance tables, and hospital capabilities are unverified.","unknowns":["Hospitals shown are mapped major hospitals (emergency tag or large campus); their emergency services, capacity and current status are not verified.","Fire-spread zones use a published rule of thumb (forward spread about 10% of the open wind speed, for forests and shrublands). Grass fires can move faster; built-up areas burn differently. It is not a fire-behaviour model.","Embers can start spot fires well ahead of the main fire; leave early.","The yellow band (±22.5° around the wind direction) is a SafeGround buffer for wind uncertainty."],"valid_while":["Wind from 45° (±22.5°) at 6.0 m/s"]}
